explication: noVNC is a browser-based VNC client library and application. A user connects through the UI to a VNC server over WebSockets; the RFB client negotiates authentication, decodes server updates, renders the remote desktop, and sends input and clipboard data back. The README documents multiple authentication methods, encodings, display scaling/clipping/resizing, touch gestures, local cursor rendering, and translations. Sampled source confirms selected UI, RFB, display, and decoder responsibilities; unsampled subsystem wiring is shown only where the product workflow supports it.
